notes: Stories added for FEAT-1 Provider Search

stories.title: Define Provider Search Request/Response Schema
stories.description: Create and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, specialty, location filters) and structured response output including provider metadata and ranking signals.

stories.title: Implement Vector Search with Taxonomy Fallback
stories.description: Build core provider search logic using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embedding queries and fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based search when vector results are insufficient.

stories.title: Integrate Location Filtering (State/City/County)
stories.description: Enhance provider search with multi-stage geographic filtering including FIPS-to-county mapping and hierarchical narrowing (state → city → county).

stories.title: Expose Provider Search via Facade and Tool Router
stories.description: Wire provider search service into find_care_facade and expose via tool_router for LLM tool-use with validated inputs and structured outputs.

stories.title: Add Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Search
stories.description: Develop unit tests for provider search service and integration tests validating end-to-end tool invocation, including vector search, fallback logic, and location filtering.
